title: Primitive Recursiveness of Rank
statement: For a bit string $s$, let $r(s)$ be the natural number obtained by appending a $1$ to $s$, interpreting the resulting string in least-significant-bit-first binary, and subtracting $1$. The function $s\mapsto r(s)$ is primitive recursive.
